column2: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم
وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون
ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل الوريد
Fabi ayyi aalaa i rabbikuma tukazziban
Wal asr innal insana lafi khusr
Guide us to the straight path
Recite in the name of your Lord who created
And He found you lost and guided
We are closer to him than his jugular vein
so which of the favors of your Lord would you deny
and the hereafter is better for you than the first life
Assalamu alaikum bhai, kya haal hai
In the name of God, I start my work
Allah is the greatest, what a day
Rabbana, aap sab ko khush rakhe
لا إله إلا الله، الحمد لله على السلامة
